officialPhotos.visualInspection: Direct image inspected in own Chrome tab2026-11-10. A rhythmic row of large orange-red tilted square/cube forms, each held on a short dark square column; varying heights, on a low reddish-brown rectangular base beside a broad pale grid-paved plaza.

Direct photograph inspected in own Chrome tab. Cream-gray concrete bridge/arcade with repeated round openings and a distinctly wavy top parapet; muted green lake, rounded boulder banks and low metal railing. Clear open water dominates the scene.
Additional official indexed photograph from park-water article:bridge, pond, stone edge and tree line. Indexed visual description only.

distinguishingMotifs: Broad quiet lake with muted green water, edged by rounded pale stones.
Long pale concrete bridge/arcade with a row of large semicircular openings.
The bridge has an undulating wave-like solid top edge, a stronger identifier than an ordinary humpback railing.
Low shore railings, open grass and rounded tree groups frame the water; modern city blocks stay background context.

A distinctive row of tilted orange-red square/cube forms on short charcoal columns, mounted on a low reddish-brown base beside the plaza. This is the strongest verified sculpture reference; no artwork title or sculptor attribution is assumed.
materialColors: Deep green trees and fresh grass

Charcoal square support columns and reddish-brown base
pixelPriorities: Use the red tilted-square sculpture row as a clear foreground art anchor, with the lake and wavy arcade bridge behind.
Reduce the sculpture to a readable rhythmic sequence of red diamond-like cube faces on dark stems; do not invent a human statue or fountain hero.
